blocks.zh: 試車與確效：水系統驗證取樣計畫、接受標準與變更管制
blocks.en: Commissioning and Qualification: Water System Sampling Program, Acceptance Criteria and Change Control

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解水系統確效（Qualification）文件的特殊要求，以及為何水系統需要「超越一般設備」的額外關注
blocks.en: Understand the special requirements for water system qualification documentation, and why water systems need "more attention than ordinary equipment"

blocks.zh: 掌握三階段取樣計畫（Phase 1 / 2 / 3）的目的、持續時間與取樣策略差異
blocks.en: Master the purpose, duration and sampling strategy differences of the three-phase sampling program (Phase 1 / 2 / 3)

blocks.zh: 理解化學與微生物接受標準的建立邏輯，包括 Alert / Action Limit 的概念
blocks.en: Understand the logic behind setting chemical and microbiological acceptance criteria, including the concept of Alert / Action Limits

blocks.zh: 認識確效報告的撰寫時機與審批流程（中期報告 vs. 總結報告）
blocks.en: Know when qualification reports are written and how they are approved (interim report vs. final summary report)

blocks.zh: 掌握變更管制與再確效（Requalification）的觸發機制
blocks.en: Master the triggers for change control and requalification

blocks.zh: 建立與 ISPE Vol.5 C&Q 框架的交叉參照概念
blocks.en: Build a cross-reference to the ISPE Vol.5 C&Q framework

blocks.zh: 10.2 System Qualification Documentation 系統確效文件
blocks.en: 10.2 System Qualification Documentation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：水系統文件為何需要「額外關注」
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why Water System Documentation Needs "Extra Attention"

blocks.zh: 一般設備的確效文件通常是標準 IQ/OQ/PQ 套路，但水系統之所以特殊，是因為：
blocks.en: Qualification documentation for ordinary equipment usually follows the standard IQ/OQ/PQ pattern, but water systems are special because:

blocks.zh: 直接接觸產品：水是最常用的製藥原料/清洗溶劑，對產品品質影響直接且廣泛
blocks.en: Direct product contact: Water is the most widely used pharmaceutical raw material and cleaning solvent, so its effect on product quality is direct and broad

blocks.zh: 持續運行系統：不像單一設備可以批次驗證，水系統 24/7 運作，品質必須時刻維持
blocks.en: Continuously operating system: Unlike a single piece of equipment that can be verified batch by batch, a water system runs 24/7 and quality must be maintained at all times

blocks.zh: 動態微生物風險：水系統的微生物負荷會隨時間、季節、使用率變化
blocks.en: Dynamic microbial risk: The microbial load in a water system changes with time, season and usage rate

blocks.zh: 因此，文件必須涵蓋更多工程細節（等角圖、焊接紀錄、坡度驗證等），不能只有「通過/不通過」的簡單記錄。
blocks.en: The documentation therefore has to cover far more engineering detail (isometric drawings, weld records, slope verification, etc.), not just a simple pass/fail record.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：等角圖（Isometric Diagram）的實務價值
blocks.en: Key Point: The Practical Value of the Isometric Diagram

blocks.zh: 原文特別提到 isometric diagram 要標示：
blocks.en: The original text specifically says the isometric diagram must show:

blocks.zh: 焊接位置與編號 — 每一道焊接都可追溯
blocks.en: Weld locations and numbers — every weld is traceable

blocks.zh: 相對高程 — 確認管路排水性
blocks.en: Relative elevations — to confirm the piping drains properly

blocks.zh: 管路坡度 — 防止積水造成微生物溫床
blocks.en: Pipe slope — to prevent standing water that becomes a breeding ground for microorganisms

blocks.zh: 排水點 — 確認系統可完全排空
blocks.en: Drain points — to confirm the system can be drained completely

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的稽查中，稽查員經常要求「帶我去看這道焊縫在哪裡」。如果等角圖與現場不一致，就是重大 observation。
blocks.en: In CDMO audits, inspectors often ask, "Take me to where this weld is." If the isometric diagram does not match the installation on site, it is a major observation.

blocks.zh: 交叉參照：ISPE Vol.5 C&Q 框架
blocks.en: Cross-Reference: ISPE Vol.5 C&Q Framework

blocks.zh: 原文最後提到「詳細內容請參考 ISPE Commissioning and Qualification Baseline Guide」，即 ISPE Vol.5。Vol.5 提供的框架包括：
blocks.en: The original text ends by saying "refer to the ISPE Commissioning and Qualification Baseline Guide for details", i.e. ISPE Vol.5. The framework provided in Vol.5 includes:

blocks.zh: 系統分類（Direct / Indirect / No Impact）— 決定確效深度
blocks.en: System classification (Direct / Indirect / No Impact) — determines the depth of qualification

blocks.zh: 風險評估驅動的測試 — 不是所有項目都需要 GMP 確效
blocks.en: Risk-assessment-driven testing — not every item needs GMP qualification

blocks.zh: Leveraging Commissioning — 利用試車數據作為確效證據
blocks.en: Leveraging Commissioning — using commissioning data as qualification evidence

blocks.zh: 水系統在 Vol.5 框架中屬於 Direct Impact System，因此所有確效測試都需要完整的 GMP 文件支持。但 Vol.5 的核心訊息是：良好的 commissioning 可以大幅減少確效階段的重複工作。
blocks.en: In the Vol.5 framework, a water system is a Direct Impact System, so all qualification tests need full GMP documentation support. But the core message of Vol.5 is that good commissioning can greatly reduce duplicated work in the qualification phase.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 水系統的確效文件就像一棟大樓的「竣工檔案」。普通住宅可能只需要基本的電氣和消防檢查報告，但醫院（相當於水系統的關鍵等級）需要的文件遠遠更多：每一段管路的X光焊檢報告、空調系統的平衡報告、緊急電源的切換測試紀錄……因為一旦出問題，影響的是病患安全。
blocks.en: Water system qualification documentation is like the "as-built file" of a building. An ordinary house may need only basic electrical and fire safety inspection reports, but a hospital (the equivalent of a critical-grade water system) needs far more: X-ray weld inspection reports for every pipe run, balancing reports for the air-conditioning system, switchover test records for the emergency power... because when something goes wrong, patient safety is affected.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 原文列出六類文件。如果你只能優先完成三類，你會選哪三個？為什麼？
blocks.en: The original text lists six categories of documents. If you could finish only three first, which three would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 原文說確效測試「may or may not be subject to a pre-approved protocol」。在你的公司，確效測試是否使用預核准方案？不使用的風險是什麼？
blocks.en: The original text says qualification tests "may or may not be subject to a pre-approved protocol". In your company, do qualification tests use pre-approved protocols? What is the risk of not using them?

blocks.zh: 10.3 System Qualification Sampling Program 系統確效取樣計畫
blocks.en: 10.3 System Qualification Sampling Program

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何水系統確效需要「時間」
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why Water System Qualification Takes "Time"

blocks.zh: 大多數設備確效可以在幾天到幾週內完成。但水系統的確效整個流程需要 超過一年，原因有三：
blocks.en: Most equipment qualification can be completed in days to weeks. But the whole water system qualification process takes more than a year, for three reasons:

blocks.zh: 微生物行為的時間依賴性：Biofilm 的建立與成熟需要數週到數月
blocks.en: Time dependence of microbial behavior: Biofilm takes weeks to months to form and mature

blocks.zh: 進水水質的季節變化：夏季微生物負荷高、冬季水溫低影響系統效率
blocks.en: Seasonal variation in feed water quality: Microbial load is higher in summer, and low water temperature in winter affects system efficiency

blocks.zh: 使用模式的變異：生產旺季/淡季的用水量差異會影響管路內水的滯留時間
blocks.en: Variation in usage patterns: Differences in water demand between peak and off-peak production seasons affect the residence time of water in the piping

blocks.zh: 所以，水系統確效不是「拍一張快照」，而是「錄一整年的影片」來證明系統在所有合理操作條件下都能穩定運作。
blocks.en: So water system qualification is not "taking a snapshot" but "recording a full year of video" to prove that the system operates stably under all reasonable operating conditions.

blocks.zh:
Phase 1
2-4 weeks
建立操作範圍
blocks.en:
Phase 1
2-4 weeks
Establish operating ranges

blocks.zh:
Phase 2
2-4 weeks
證明一致性
blocks.en:
Phase 2
2-4 weeks
Demonstrate consistency

blocks.zh:
Phase 3
1 year
長期性能驗證
blocks.en:
Phase 3
1 year
Long-term performance verification

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Phase 期間水可以用於生產嗎？
blocks.en: Key Point: Can the Water Be Used for Production During the Phases?

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：只要分析結果合格，各階段產生的水都可以用於生產。這對 CDMO 非常重要，因為新廠或新系統在確效期間不能生產 = 一整年沒有營收。
blocks.en: The original text states clearly: water produced in each phase may be used for production, as long as the analytical results are acceptable. This is very important for a CDMO, because a new facility or new system that cannot produce during qualification = a whole year with no revenue.

blocks.zh: 實務上的做法是：
blocks.en: In practice:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 完成後，如果所有結果合格，通常會發一份 interim report 來支持「有條件使用」
blocks.en: After Phase 1, if all results are acceptable, an interim report is usually issued to support "conditional use"

blocks.zh: Phase 2 完成後發正式核准，允許常規生產使用
blocks.en: After Phase 2, formal approval is issued, allowing routine production use

blocks.zh: Phase 3 是在正常生產狀態下持續監控
blocks.en: Phase 3 is continued monitoring under normal production conditions

blocks.zh: 關鍵是：你必須事先在 protocol 中定義「在什麼條件下允許使用」，而不是事後追認。
blocks.en: The key is that you must define in the protocol in advance "under what conditions use is allowed", rather than ratifying it after the fact.

blocks.zh: 想像你開了一家新餐廳。Phase 1 是試營運（soft opening）：測試菜單、調整流程、訓練團隊。Phase 2 是邀請制營業（limited opening）：證明你可以穩定出餐、品質一致。Phase 3 是正式營業的第一年：經歷過暑假旺季、冬天淡季、春節高峰，才能真正說「我們的品質是穩定的」。
blocks.en: Imagine opening a new restaurant. Phase 1 is the soft opening: testing the menu, adjusting workflows, training the team. Phase 2 is limited opening (by invitation): proving you can serve consistently with consistent quality. Phase 3 is the first full year of operation: only after getting through the summer peak, the winter slow season and the Lunar New Year rush can you truly say "our quality is stable."

blocks.zh: 10.3.1 Phase 1 — Intensive Monitoring 第一階段：密集監控
blocks.en: 10.3.1 Phase 1 — Intensive Monitoring

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Phase 1 的三大產出
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three Outputs of Phase 1

blocks.zh: Phase 1 不只是「取樣」，它要產出三項關鍵成果：
blocks.en: Phase 1 is not just "sampling"; it must produce three key results:

blocks.zh: 操作範圍（Operating Ranges）：基於實際數據而非設計假設的系統運行參數
blocks.en: Operating ranges: System operating parameters based on actual data rather than design assumptions

blocks.zh: SOP 初版：操作、清洗、消毒的標準作業程序，經過實際驗證
blocks.en: Initial SOPs: Standard operating procedures for operation, cleaning and sanitization, verified in actual use

blocks.zh: 偏差調查流程：如何區分「局部問題」和「系統性問題」的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Deviation investigation process: The decision logic for distinguishing a "localized problem" from a "systematic problem"

blocks.zh: 重點提示：每個使用點都要取樣
blocks.en: Key Point: Every Point of Use Must Be Sampled

blocks.zh: 原文強調 sampling from each point of use。這在大型水系統中意味著：
blocks.en: The original text stresses sampling from each point of use. In a large water system this means:

blocks.zh: 一個典型的 CDMO WFI loop 可能有 20-40 個使用點
blocks.en: A typical CDMO WFI loop may have 20-40 points of use

blocks.zh: 每天每個點取樣 = 每天 20-40 個樣本
blocks.en: Sampling every point daily = 20-40 samples per day
Over 2-4 weeks = 280-1,120 samples

blocks.zh: 這是非常大的工作量和成本。因此，取樣計畫的設計必須在「統計有效性」和「實務可行性」之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: This is a very large workload and cost. The sampling program must therefore be designed to balance "statistical validity" against "practical feasibility".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：Localized vs. Systematic Failure
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Localized vs. Systematic Failure

blocks.zh: 原文要求在 Phase 1 結束前建立偏差調查流程，區分：
blocks.en: The original text requires a deviation investigation process to be established before the end of Phase 1, distinguishing between:

blocks.zh: 局部問題（Localized）：例如某個特定使用點的閥門汙染 — 只需清洗該點並增加取樣頻率
blocks.en: Localized problems: for example, a contaminated valve at one specific point of use — only that point needs to be cleaned and its sampling frequency increased

blocks.zh: 系統性問題（Systematic）：例如整個迴路的微生物計數都在上升 — 可能需要整個系統消毒，甚至暫停使用
blocks.en: Systematic problems: for example, microbial counts rising across the entire loop — the whole system may need to be sanitized, or even taken out of service

blocks.zh: CDMO 的痛點：客戶產品正在生產線上，如果判斷為系統性問題需要停機消毒，營收損失和客戶關係的衝擊都很大。所以這個調查流程的邏輯必須在 Phase 1 就建立好，不能等到問題發生才臨時決定。
blocks.en: The CDMO pain point: customer products are on the production line, and if a systematic problem is judged to require shutdown and sanitization, the revenue loss and the impact on customer relationships are significant. The logic of this investigation process must therefore be established in Phase 1, not decided ad hoc after a problem occurs.

blocks.zh: 原文說 FDA 建議每天取樣 2-4 週，但也承認「other sampling programs may be acceptable」。如果你要設計一個「替代方案」，你的科學理據（scientific rationale）會是什麼？
blocks.en: The original text says FDA recommends daily sampling for 2-4 weeks, but also acknowledges that "other sampling programs may be acceptable". If you were to design an "alternative program", what would your scientific rationale be?

blocks.zh: Phase 1 結束時，如果某些取樣點的微生物結果偏高但仍在規格內，你會如何處理？直接進入 Phase 2 還是延長 Phase 1？
blocks.en: At the end of Phase 1, if microbial results at some sampling points are high but still within specification, how would you handle it? Proceed directly to Phase 2, or extend Phase 1?

blocks.zh: 10.3.2 Phase 2 — Consistent Operation 第二階段：一致性驗證
blocks.en: 10.3.2 Phase 2 — Consistent Operation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Phase 2 的核心要求 — 「一致性」
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Core Requirement of Phase 2 — "Consistency"

blocks.zh: Phase 1 證明了「系統可以產出合格的水」，Phase 2 要證明的是「系統每次都能產出合格的水」。這兩者的差異就像：
blocks.en: Phase 1 showed that "the system can produce acceptable water"; Phase 2 must show that "the system produces acceptable water every time". The difference is like this:

blocks.zh: Phase 1：「這個投手可以投出 150km/h 的球」
blocks.en: Phase 1: "This pitcher can throw a 150 km/h pitch"

blocks.zh: Phase 2：「這個投手每場比賽都能穩定投出 150km/h 的球」
blocks.en: Phase 2: "This pitcher can throw 150 km/h pitches in every game"

blocks.zh: 重點提示：取樣方法必須「代表實際使用方式」
blocks.en: Key Point: The Sampling Method Must "Represent Actual Use"

blocks.zh: 這是一個常被忽略但極為重要的原則。原文舉了兩個例子：
blocks.en: This is a principle that is often overlooked but extremely important. The original text gives two examples:

blocks.zh: 不要長時間預沖：如果實際使用時是「打開閥門直接用」，取樣時也應該直接取，不應該先沖 5 分鐘。否則你取到的是「沖洗後的好水」，不是「使用者實際拿到的水」。
blocks.en: Do not pre-flush for a long time: If in actual use the valve is simply opened and the water used directly, sampling should also be done directly, not after flushing for 5 minutes. Otherwise you are collecting "water after flushing", not "the water the user actually gets".

blocks.zh: 從軟管末端取樣：如果使用點接了軟管，取樣就要從軟管末端取，因為軟管本身可能是汙染源。
blocks.en: Sample from the end of the hose: If a hose is attached to the point of use, sample from the end of the hose, because the hose itself may be a source of contamination.

blocks.zh: 隱藏陷阱：過度取樣反而掩蓋問題
blocks.en: Hidden Trap: Over-Sampling Can Mask Problems

blocks.zh: 原文有一句非常重要但容易被忽略的警告：
blocks.en: The original text contains a very important warning that is easily missed:

blocks.zh: 意思是：如果某個使用點平常很少用（例如備用管路），頻繁取樣等於頻繁沖洗，反而把正在形成的 biofilm 沖掉了。取樣結果看起來很好，但實際上問題被掩蓋了。
blocks.en: This means that if a point of use is rarely used (for example, a standby line), frequent sampling amounts to frequent flushing, which washes away biofilm that is starting to form. The sampling results look good, but the problem is actually being masked.

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議：對低使用率的 point of use，取樣頻率應該模擬實際使用頻率，而不是為了「數據好看」而天天取樣。
blocks.en: CDMO recommendation: for low-usage points of use, the sampling frequency should simulate the actual usage frequency, rather than sampling every day to make the data "look good".

blocks.zh: Phase 2 的另一個關鍵產出是建立 Alert / Action Limit：
blocks.en: Another key output of Phase 2 is the establishment of Alert / Action Limits:

blocks.zh: Alert Limit（警戒限）：趨勢偏離的早期警告，通常觸發增加取樣頻率和調查
blocks.en: Alert Limit: An early warning of a trend deviation, usually triggering increased sampling frequency and investigation

blocks.zh: Action Limit（行動限）：接近規格邊界，觸發糾正行動（消毒、維修等）
blocks.en: Action Limit: Close to the specification boundary, triggering corrective action (sanitization, repair, etc.)

blocks.zh: 這些限值應基於 Phase 1 和 Phase 2 的實際數據統計建立，而非僅引用 USP 或行業慣例。
blocks.en: These limits should be established from a statistical analysis of actual data from Phase 1 and Phase 2, rather than simply quoting USP or industry convention.

blocks.zh: 10.3.3 Phase 3 — Extended Performance 第三階段：長期性能驗證
blocks.en: 10.3.3 Phase 3 — Extended Performance

blocks.zh: 核心概念：一年 = 四季全覆蓋
blocks.en: Key Concept: One Year = All Four Seasons Covered

blocks.zh: Phase 3 的持續時間是一年，目的不是「多取一年的樣」，而是要確保系統經歷過所有可能的環境變化：
blocks.en: Phase 3 lasts one year. The purpose is not "another year of samples" but to make sure the system goes through all possible environmental changes:

blocks.zh: 春季：融雪導致進水水質劣化（有機物、微生物增加）
blocks.en: Spring: Snowmelt degrades feed water quality (more organics and microorganisms)

blocks.zh: 夏季：高溫促進微生物生長，進水水溫升高影響 RO 效率
blocks.en: Summer: High temperatures promote microbial growth, and warmer feed water affects RO efficiency

blocks.zh: 秋季：落葉季節影響地表水質
blocks.en: Autumn: Falling leaves affect surface water quality

blocks.zh: 冬季：低溫影響系統效率，但微生物風險較低
blocks.en: Winter: Low temperatures affect system efficiency, but microbial risk is lower

blocks.zh: 台灣的情境也類似：梅雨季（進水濁度高）、颱風季（可能影響市水供應）、夏季高溫等都是必須涵蓋的變異情境。
blocks.en: The situation in Taiwan is similar: the plum rain season (high feed water turbidity), the typhoon season (possible disruption of municipal water supply) and high summer temperatures are all variable conditions that must be covered.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：WFI 的取樣頻率要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Sampling Frequency Requirements for WFI

blocks.zh: 對 WFI 系統，FDA 的建議取樣頻率是：
blocks.en: For WFI systems, FDA's recommended sampling frequency is:

blocks.zh: 每日：至少從一個使用點取樣
blocks.en: Daily: Sample from at least one point of use

blocks.zh: 每週：所有使用點都要取到
blocks.en: Weekly: All points of use must be sampled

blocks.zh: 注意這是 Phase 3（長期監控）的頻率，比 Phase 1/2 已經降低。但對 Purified Water（PW）系統，指南沒有這麼嚴格的要求 — 這反映了 WFI 對注射劑品質的關鍵影響。
blocks.en: Note that this is the frequency for Phase 3 (long-term monitoring) and is already lower than in Phase 1/2. For Purified Water (PW) systems, the guide does not have such strict requirements, which reflects the critical effect of WFI on injectable product quality.

blocks.zh: Phase 3 就像新車的「第一年保固期」。製造商讓你在各種路況、天氣、負載條件下開一年，如果一年下來車子都表現正常，才真正確認這台車的品質。同樣地，水系統要經過春夏秋冬的考驗，才能說「驗證完成」。
blocks.en: Phase 3 is like the "first-year warranty" of a new car. The manufacturer has you drive it for a year in all kinds of road, weather and load conditions, and only if the car performs normally throughout the year is its quality truly confirmed. Likewise, a water system has to be tested through spring, summer, autumn and winter before you can say "validation is complete".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：Phase 3 期間的商業運營
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Commercial Operations During Phase 3

blocks.zh: 好消息是：Phase 3 通常在正常生產狀態下進行，不需要額外的停機時間。但需注意：
blocks.en: The good news is that Phase 3 is usually carried out under normal production conditions and needs no additional downtime. But note:

blocks.zh: Phase 3 期間的偏差（OOS/OOT）仍需正式調查和處理
blocks.en: Deviations (OOS/OOT) during Phase 3 still require formal investigation and handling

blocks.zh: 如果 Phase 3 期間出現重大系統變更，可能需要重新評估是否「重啟」Phase 3
blocks.en: If a major system change occurs during Phase 3, you may need to reassess whether to "restart" Phase 3

blocks.zh: Phase 3 的最終報告是水系統完整驗證的關鍵文件，稽查員必看
blocks.en: The final Phase 3 report is the key document for the complete validation of the water system, and inspectors will always look at it

blocks.zh: 10.4 Acceptance Criteria 接受標準
blocks.en: 10.4 Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「樣本平均值」接受標準
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Sample Average" Acceptance Criterion

blocks.zh: 原文提出一個非常實用的概念：對 WFI 系統，除了單一樣本的限值外，應建立 sample average acceptance criterion。
blocks.en: The original text presents a very practical concept: for WFI systems, in addition to limits for individual samples, a sample average acceptance criterion should be established.

blocks.zh: 邏輯是：WFI 系統（通常 80°C 以上循環或使用蒸餾法）本質上是抑菌的。如果系統設計和運行正常，大多數樣本結果應該遠低於 10 CFU/100ml。如果平均值接近限值，即使每個單一樣本都「合格」，系統仍然有問題。
blocks.en: The logic is that a WFI system (usually circulating at 80°C or above, or using distillation) is inherently bacteriostatic. If the system is designed and operated properly, most sample results should be well below 10 CFU/100 ml. If the average is close to the limit, the system still has a problem even if every individual sample "passes".

blocks.zh: 建議的做法：
blocks.en: Suggested approach:

blocks.zh: Action Limit: 10 CFU/100ml（單一樣本）
blocks.en: Action Limit: 10 CFU/100 ml (single sample)

blocks.zh: Alert Limit: 1-3 CFU/100ml（基於實際數據的統計分析）
blocks.en: Alert Limit: 1-3 CFU/100 ml (based on statistical analysis of actual data)

blocks.zh: 平均值目標: <1 CFU/100ml（系統正常運行的預期表現）
blocks.en: Average target: <1 CFU/100 ml (expected performance of a system operating normally)

blocks.zh: 重要觀點：化學失敗的嚴肅性
blocks.en: Important Point: The Seriousness of Chemical Failures

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：化學分析失敗比微生物失敗更為嚴重。原因是：
blocks.en: The original text states clearly that a chemical analysis failure is more serious than a microbiological failure. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 一個「設計良好」的水系統不應該出現化學不合格
blocks.en: A "well-designed" water system should not have chemical failures

blocks.zh: 化學不合格代表系統設計或運行有根本問題
blocks.en: A chemical failure indicates a fundamental problem in system design or operation

blocks.zh: 必須找到根本原因、糾正、然後延長取樣期重新證明一致性
blocks.en: The root cause must be found and corrected, then the sampling period extended to demonstrate consistency again

blocks.zh: 相比之下，微生物偶爾偏高可能是取樣操作、環境因素等造成，單次偏移加重取樣合格是可接受的。
blocks.en: By comparison, an occasional high microbial result may be caused by sampling technique, environmental factors and so on, and a single excursion followed by acceptable resampling is acceptable.

blocks.zh: 化學指標就像人的「血壓」— 一個設計良好的身體（系統），血壓應該一直正常。偶爾偏高一次可能是緊張，但如果持續偏高就是系統問題。微生物指標則像「感冒次數」— 即使很健康的人也可能偶爾感冒（偶發微生物偏移），但如果經常感冒就要查免疫系統（系統性問題）。
blocks.en: Chemical parameters are like a person's "blood pressure": in a well-built body (system), blood pressure should always be normal. An occasional high reading may be nerves, but persistently high readings point to a systemic problem. Microbial parameters are more like "the number of colds": even a very healthy person may catch an occasional cold (a sporadic microbial excursion), but if it happens often you need to check the immune system (a systematic problem).

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統在 Phase 1 期間，某個使用點連續兩天微生物結果為 5 CFU/100ml（低於 10 CFU/100ml 的限值但明顯高於其他點的 <1 CFU/100ml）。你會如何處理？
blocks.en: During Phase 1 of your WFI system, one point of use gives a microbial result of 5 CFU/100 ml on two consecutive days (below the 10 CFU/100 ml limit but clearly higher than the <1 CFU/100 ml at other points). How would you handle it?

blocks.zh: 原文說化學失敗時需要「extended sampling phase」。如果 Phase 2 第三週出現一次 conductivity 失敗，後來確認是取樣瓶汙染，你是否仍需延長 Phase 2？為什麼？
blocks.en: The original text says an "extended sampling phase" is needed when a chemical failure occurs. If a conductivity failure occurs in week 3 of Phase 2 and is later confirmed to be caused by a contaminated sample bottle, do you still need to extend Phase 2? Why?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求 PW 系統的微生物限值設為 10 CFU/ml（比 USP 建議的 100 CFU/ml 嚴格 10 倍）。你會如何評估這個要求的合理性？
blocks.en: Your customer requires the microbial limit for the PW system to be 10 CFU/ml (10 times stricter than the 100 CFU/ml recommended by USP). How would you evaluate the reasonableness of this requirement?

blocks.zh: 10.5 Qualification Reports 確效報告
blocks.en: 10.5 Qualification Reports

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Interim Report 的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of the Interim Report

blocks.zh: Interim report 是 CDMO 營運的關鍵文件。沒有它，你不能在確效期間使用水進行生產。撰寫時應包含：
blocks.en: The interim report is a key document for CDMO operations. Without it, you cannot use the water for production during qualification. It should include:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 所有數據的彙整與統計分析
blocks.en: Compilation and statistical analysis of all Phase 1 data

blocks.zh: 所有測試項目的合格/不合格判定
blocks.en: Pass/fail determination for all test items

blocks.zh: 任何偏差及其調查結論
blocks.en: Any deviations and their investigation conclusions

blocks.zh: 有條件使用的限制（如適用）
blocks.en: Restrictions on conditional use (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 後續 Phase 2/3 的取樣計畫確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of the sampling plan for the subsequent Phase 2/3

blocks.zh: 這份報告必須經過 QA 審核和核准。稽查員看到這份文件，才會認可你在確效期間的生產批次是合法的。
blocks.en: This report must be reviewed and approved by QA. Only when inspectors see this document will they accept that production batches made during qualification were legitimate.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Recommendations

blocks.zh: 建議在 Phase 3 的 periodic updates 中加入趨勢分析圖表：
blocks.en: It is recommended to include trend analysis charts in the periodic updates during Phase 3:

blocks.zh: 微生物計數的時間趨勢圖（每個使用點分開繪製）
blocks.en: Time trend charts of microbial counts (plotted separately for each point of use)

blocks.zh: conductivity 和 TOC 的趨勢圖
blocks.en: Trend charts of conductivity and TOC

blocks.zh: 進水水質的季節變化對照
blocks.en: Comparison with seasonal changes in feed water quality

blocks.zh: 消毒/維護事件的時間標記
blocks.en: Time markers for sanitization/maintenance events

blocks.zh: 這些圖表不僅是確效文件的組成部分，也是日後年度產品品質回顧（APR/PQR）中水系統部分的基礎數據。
blocks.en: These charts are not only part of the qualification documentation but also the basic data for the water system section of the later Annual Product Quality Review (APR/PQR).

blocks.zh: 核心概念：確效報告的時間線
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Timeline of Qualification Reports

blocks.zh: 水系統的確效報告不是「寫一份就好」，而是一系列的文件：
blocks.en: Water system qualification reports are not "write one and done" but a series of documents:

blocks.zh: 10.6 Change Control and Requalification 變更管制與再確效
blocks.en: 10.6 Change Control and Requalification

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「整個系統」的影響評估
blocks.en: Key Point: Impact Assessment of the "Whole System"

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調要評估變更對整個系統的影響，而不只是變更點本身。原因是水系統是連續循環的封閉系統：
blocks.en: The original text specifically stresses assessing the impact of a change on the whole system, not just the point of change. The reason is that a water system is a continuously circulating closed system:

blocks.zh: 在上游更換了一個組件，可能改變整個迴路的水質
blocks.en: Replacing a component upstream may change the water quality of the whole loop

blocks.zh: 增加一個使用點，可能改變整個系統的流速分布
blocks.en: Adding a point of use may change the flow distribution of the whole system

blocks.zh: 調整消毒頻率，影響的是整個管路的微生物控制
blocks.en: Adjusting the sanitization frequency affects microbial control of the entire piping

blocks.zh: 這與一般設備的變更管制不同 — 更換一台壓錠機的模具，只影響那台機器。但更換水系統的一段管路，可能影響所有使用該水的產品。
blocks.en: This differs from change control for ordinary equipment: changing the tooling on a tablet press affects only that machine, but replacing a section of water system piping may affect every product that uses that water.

blocks.zh: 交叉參照：ISPE Vol.5 變更管制
blocks.en: Cross-Reference: ISPE Vol.5 Change Control

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.5 C&Q Guide 的 Chapter 8（Change Management）提供了更完整的變更管制框架：
blocks.en: Chapter 8 (Change Management) of the ISPE Vol.5 C&Q Guide provides a more complete change control framework:

blocks.zh: 變更分類：Like-for-Like / Minor / Major / Critical
blocks.en: Change classification: Like-for-Like / Minor / Major / Critical

blocks.zh: 風險評估工具：影響評估矩陣（Impact Assessment Matrix）
blocks.en: Risk assessment tool: Impact Assessment Matrix

blocks.zh: 再確效深度：從「文件審查」到「完整再驗證」的光譜
blocks.en: Depth of requalification: A spectrum from "document review" to "full revalidation"

blocks.zh: 建議在水系統的變更管制 SOP 中，直接引用 Vol.5 的框架，並針對水系統的特殊性（連續循環、微生物風險）增加具體的評估準則。
blocks.en: It is recommended that the water system change control SOP refer directly to the Vol.5 framework and add specific assessment criteria for the particularities of water systems (continuous circulation, microbial risk).

blocks.zh: CDMO 特別注意：客戶溝通
blocks.en: CDMO Special Consideration: Customer Communication

blocks.zh: CDMO 水系統的變更管制有一個額外維度：客戶通知。水系統的重大變更可能影響所有使用該系統的客戶產品，因此：
blocks.en: Change control for a CDMO water system has an additional dimension: customer notification. A major change to the water system may affect the products of all customers using it, so:

blocks.zh: 品質協議（QTA）中應明確定義水系統變更的通知範圍
blocks.en: The Quality Technical Agreement (QTA) should clearly define the scope of notification for water system changes

blocks.zh: 高影響變更可能需要客戶核准才能執行
blocks.en: High-impact changes may need customer approval before implementation

blocks.zh: 變更後的再確效數據可能需要提供給客戶作為其產品變更的支持文件
blocks.en: Requalification data after a change may need to be provided to customers as supporting documentation for their own product changes

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統需要更換 RO 膜（從 A 品牌換成 B 品牌，規格相同但材質不同）。你會將此歸類為哪個影響等級？需要什麼程度的再確效？
blocks.en: Your WFI system needs its RO membranes replaced (from brand A to brand B, same specification but different material). Which impact level would you assign, and what degree of requalification is needed?

blocks.zh: 生產團隊要求在 WFI loop 上增加一個新的使用點（用於新客戶的填充線）。除了管路的物理安裝，你需要考慮哪些確效和監控方面的事項？
blocks.en: The production team asks to add a new point of use on the WFI loop (for a new customer's filling line). Besides the physical piping installation, what qualification and monitoring matters do you need to consider?

blocks.zh: 你的進水（市水）供應商通知你，他們將在下個月更換消毒劑（從氯改為氯胺）。這對你的水系統有什麼潛在影響？你的變更管制流程應如何回應？
blocks.en: Your feed water (municipal water) supplier notifies you that next month they will change the disinfectant (from chlorine to chloramine). What are the potential effects on your water system? How should your change control process respond?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：變更影響的三個等級
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Levels of Change Impact

blocks.zh: 原文雖然只有短短一段，但包含了變更管制的核心框架。每個變更都應根據影響評估，對應到三種行動之一：
blocks.en: Although the original text is only a short paragraph, it contains the core framework of change control. Based on the impact assessment, every change should map to one of three actions:

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary 本章總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Key Takeaways 重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 導師總結 Instructor Summary
blocks.en: Instructor Summary

blocks.zh: 本章核心訊息
blocks.en: Core Message of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 水系統確效的本質是「用時間和數據證明系統的可靠性」。它不是一次性的「通過/不通過」測試，而是一個持續超過一年的證據積累過程。
blocks.en: The essence of water system qualification is "using time and data to prove the system's reliability". It is not a one-time pass/fail test but a process of accumulating evidence that lasts more than a year.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means:

blocks.zh: 新廠規劃：水系統確效的時程（>1年）必須納入新廠投產的整體時程規劃
blocks.en: New facility planning: The water system qualification timeline (>1 year) must be built into the overall schedule for starting up the new facility

blocks.zh: 日常運營：Phase 3 完成後，持續監控就是你的「保險」— 用持續的數據證明系統一直在控制中
blocks.en: Daily operations: After Phase 3 is complete, continued monitoring is your "insurance" — using ongoing data to prove the system has stayed in control

blocks.zh: 客戶信任：一套完整的三階段確效文件 + 持續的趨勢監控數據，是向客戶和稽查員展現水系統控制能力的最有力證據
blocks.en: Customer trust: A complete three-phase qualification package plus continuing trend monitoring data is the strongest evidence of water system control for customers and inspectors

blocks.zh: 與其他 ISPE 指南的連結
blocks.en: Links to Other ISPE Guides

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.5（C&Q Guide）：提供系統分類、風險評估、leveraging commissioning 的完整框架。水系統作為 Direct Impact System，適用最嚴格的確效要求。
blocks.en: ISPE Vol.5 (C&Q Guide): Provides the complete framework for system classification, risk assessment and leveraging commissioning. As a Direct Impact System, a water system is subject to the strictest qualification requirements.

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.4 前面章節：系統設計（Chapter 3-7）的決策直接影響確效策略 — 例如 hot loop vs. ambient loop 決定了消毒頻率和微生物控制策略。
blocks.en: Earlier chapters of ISPE Vol.4: System design decisions (Chapters 3-7) directly affect the qualification strategy. For example, a hot loop vs. an ambient loop determines the sanitization frequency and the microbial control strategy.

blocks.zh: FDA Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems：本章多次引用的 FDA 指南，提供了更具體的稽查視角。
blocks.en: FDA Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems: The FDA guide cited several times in this chapter, which offers a more specific inspection perspective.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習 Comprehensive Exercise
blocks.en: Comprehensive Exercise

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO 的工程/品質主管，公司正在建置一套新的 WFI 系統，預計 6 個月後開始供水給新的無菌充填線。請完成以下任務：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the engineering/quality head of a CDMO. The company is building a new WFI system that will start supplying a new aseptic filling line in 6 months. Complete the following tasks:

blocks.zh: 制定一份三階段取樣計畫的時間表，標註每個階段的開始條件、取樣頻率、和退出標準
blocks.en: Draft a schedule for the three-phase sampling program, marking the start conditions, sampling frequency and exit criteria for each phase

blocks.zh: 定義初步的化學和微生物接受標準，說明你的理據
blocks.en: Define preliminary chemical and microbiological acceptance criteria and explain your rationale

blocks.zh: 列出確效報告的交付時程表，標註每份報告需要哪些人審核/核准
blocks.en: List the delivery schedule for the qualification reports, marking who must review/approve each report

blocks.zh: 設計一個變更管制的決策矩陣：列出 5 種常見的水系統變更場景，分別定義影響等級和對應的再確效要求
blocks.en: Design a decision matrix for change control: list 5 common water system change scenarios and define the impact level and corresponding requalification requirements for each
